composer-2-fast.concept: You're catching translucent "commit petals" that drift down four lanes as a stutter-house kick guides the windows — miss three and the branch forks into chaos.
composer-2-fast.mechanic: Rhythm lane-switch collect — petals fall on beats, lanes drift sideways as faux wind rises.
composer-2-fast.touch_control: Thumb taps swap active lane; quick double-tap bursts a short shield.
composer-2-fast.session_hook: 45-second runs map cleanly to one song section — score is petals synced to beat accuracy.
composer-2-fast.escalation: Wind bias skews drops; occasional fake petals blink wrong-color.
composer-2-fast.aesthetic: Neon wireframe petals over dusk fog gradient, SF hill silhouette

gpt-5.4-high-fast.concept: Sort incoming crates onto ferries before harbor fog covers the dock — each crate has a tiny icon family (forge, git, patch) and only one berth accepts it.
gpt-5.4-high-fast.mechanic: Drag-sort under time pressure — wrong berth costs a life.
gpt-5.4-high-fast.touch_control: Drag from conveyor to berth slots.
gpt-5.4-high-fast.session_hook: Clearing a wave feels like merging a clean PR stack.
gpt-5.4-high-fast.escalation: Crates arrive faster; ghost crates need double-tap to reveal type.
gpt-5.4-high-fast.aesthetic: Paper cutout cranes and crates, muted nautical palette

claude-opus-4-7-thinking-max.concept: Draw a single stroke path through a grid of nodes — your line must visit signal towers in the order the fog horns sounded last round.
claude-opus-4-7-thinking-max.mechanic: Path drawing with memorized sequence constraint.
claude-opus-4-7-thinking-max.touch_control: Drag finger across nodes without lifting; undo pinch on mistake.
claude-opus-4-7-thinking-max.session_hook: Solving the loop in one fluid motion is its own reward.
claude-opus-4-7-thinking-max.escalation: Nodes add bridges (must cross twice); horns speed up.
claude-opus-4-7-thinking-max.aesthetic: Watercolor blocks and thin ink trails

gemini-3.1-pro.concept: Flick a glowing puck across a one-screen arena — it ricochets off curved seawall bumpers to hit rotating targets tied to your combo multiplier.
gemini-3.1-pro.mechanic: Physics flick ricochet with angle aiming.
gemini-3.1-pro.touch_control: Pull back and release sling-style from the puck.
gemini-3.1-pro.session_hook: Chain reactions from bumper cascades spike score in seconds.
gemini-3.1-pro.escalation: Bumpers shrink; gravity tilts slightly each wave.
gemini-3.1-pro.aesthetic: Chrome puck on moonlit bay-blue glass

kimi-k2.5.concept: Watch a ring of lighthouse beams flash a color-note pattern — reproduce it by tapping sectors in order while the ring slowly rotates.
kimi-k2.5.touch_control: Tap sectors around the ring in order.
kimi-k2.5.escalation: Ring speeds up; occasional decoy flash.
kimi-k2.5.aesthetic: Duotone amber and deep navy, grainy film overlay
